endorsements.name: Tarik Bakir
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-36970
endorsements.description: PMB 5.6 contains a local file disclosure vulnerability in getgif.php that allows attackers to read arbitrary system files by manipulating the 'chemin' parameter. Attackers can exploit the unsanitized file path input to access sensitive files like /etc/passwd by sending crafted requests to the getgif.php endpoint.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.4)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Tarik Bakir
endorsements.label: CVE-2020-37105
endorsements.description: PMB 5.6 contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the administration download script that allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary SQL commands through the 'logid' parameter. Attackers can leverage this vulnerability by sending crafted requests to the /admin/sauvegarde/download.php endpoint with manipulated logid values to interact with the database.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 7.1)
